coordinateSpace: original screenshot pixels; nominal 3px per logical unit is inferred, not guaranteed

findings.region: Unoccluded margins, excluding imagery, status bars and footer
findings.approximateMeasurement: Repeated flat RGB(246,246,246), sampled original pixels at (20,500), (1100,1100), (600,1950), (10,600)
findings.conclusion: Main light canvas is approximately #F6F6F6; welcome screen 001 differs around #F0F0F0.

findings.region: Card interior excluding text, imagery and shadows
findings.approximateMeasurement: Repeated flat RGB(253,253,253) at 034:(80,1650), 127:(700,1810); adopt white #FFFFFF
findings.conclusion: White cards are subtly brighter than the neutral field; use stable white for Afterglow card content.

findings.approximateMeasurement: 001 button approximately x=72..1107, y=2330..2485 original pixels; radius near half its height; broad horizontal pill
findings.conclusion: Black pill primary actions, white labels. White secondary pills with subtle diffuse shadow recur.

findings.approximateMeasurement: Reference diameter approximately 118–124 original pixels, about 40–41 logical units under 3x hypothesis; increase to 44 minimum
findings.conclusion: Use circular IconButton with at least 44x44 touch area. Pressed/focus treatment is an Afterglow adaptation, not extracted motion.

findings.region: Page edges, row gaps, card padding
findings.approximateMeasurement: Outer margin roughly 46–50 original pixels (~16 logical); inner card padding roughly 48–60px (~16–20); repeated gaps near 24–48px
findings.conclusion: Adopt spacing 4/8/12/16/24/32/48 and a 16-unit page gutter; retain product world gutter separately.

findings.approximateMeasurement: Outer corner radius roughly 64–84 original pixels (~21–28 logical); sheet top radius closer to 90–110px
findings.conclusion: Large rounded surfaces and inset content; Afterglow list Card radius 24, Sheet 32. Spatial memory cards retain specified 16-unit corners.

findings.region: Actual UI heading, list title and metadata; exclude logo/sticker/handwriting
findings.approximateMeasurement: Body approximately 42–50px high in original raster; titles approximately 60–75px; exact font metrics cannot be recovered from glyph raster height
findings.conclusion: Use platform System sans as an explicitly substituted font, weights 400/500/600/700, body 16/24, caption 13/18, title 24/30, display 32/38. Exact original family/license unknown.

findings.region: Circular portraits, initials fallback and names
findings.approximateMeasurement: List avatars roughly 118–145px (~40–48 units); profile portrait roughly 285px (~96 units); initials visible in 042 and 056
findings.conclusion: Circular Avatar with named/initials fallback; optional overlapping AvatarGroup only for identity, never primary memory cards.

findings.region: Selection checks and selected tab/action capsules
findings.approximateMeasurement: Filled black circle/check, pale inactive control surfaces, icon and text used together
findings.conclusion: Chip and SegmentedControl expose semantic selected state and visible check or emphasis; selection never relies on hue alone.

findings.region: Status copy, error notification, skeleton and finalized row
findings.approximateMeasurement: Green success text, coral/red errors, pale image/text skeleton; notifications are rounded horizontal surfaces
findings.conclusion: Loading, error, success and skeleton states are evidenced. Timing, shimmer, haptics and transitions are unknown static-screen behavior.

findings.region: Overlay silhouette, handle, backdrop and action layout
findings.approximateMeasurement: Sheets inset about 24px (~8 units) from export edge, radius ~100px (~33 units); scrim roughly 20% black over #F6F6F6
findings.conclusion: Use native Modal-backed Sheet and ConfirmDialog, explicit close/Cancel, native Back, modal accessibility and focus restoration. Blur is adapted to a solid stable surface.

findings.region: Arrow, image, edit, trash and user glyphs
findings.approximateMeasurement: Mostly thin outline glyphs around 20–24 logical units; filled selected icons and circular containers
findings.conclusion: Use licensed Feather icons through Expo as a documented substitute. Do not reuse Bond marks or third-party service icons.

findings.region: Secondary text, validation and connection action colors
findings.approximateMeasurement: Observed gray near #8E8E8E is too weak for small text on the field; use #626262. Adopt danger #B4232C, success #246B3C, focus #006AB5
findings.conclusion: Preserve neutral hierarchy while darkening text/status colors for contrast. Blue social actions do not authorize a generic all-blue primary system.

findings.region: Photo library, photo viewing and story editor
findings.approximateMeasurement: Dark surfaces appear in media/editor contexts; ordinary home/profile/memory lists remain light
findings.conclusion: Ship a light theme only; contextual dark media views are documented, not evidence of complete dark-theme tokens.

findings.region: Photo framing, story content and attribution
findings.approximateMeasurement: Afterglow specification: canonical width 308, minimum world gap 16, card padding/corner 16, camera scale .75..1.25
findings.conclusion: Photos/stories use separated cards with metadata below stable imagery. Do not import tilted overlapping story thumbnails, photo-overlaid body text, social counts, OTP or voice behaviors.

findings.region: Errors, loading, empty, selected and pending states
findings.approximateMeasurement: No screenshot proves hover/focus transitions, upload-percent visuals, native text scaling or reduced-motion behavior
findings.conclusion: Pressed/focus/disabled/upload progress and reduced-motion states are designed adaptations; test them separately from reference fidelity.
